reviewer_state.cross_story_model_snapshot: S1 + S2 closed (fixpoint reached both). CARRY TO S3 — this is the story every item targets: (1) S2-F4 - formatTokenViewText indexes by UTF-16 code unit; byte-level BPE can end a token mid-character; AC-TOK-6's fullUnicodeString generator surfaces it. Decide: tokenize() guarantees character-aligned boundaries, or the formatter snaps off low surrogates. (2) S2-F11 - fold TokenViewHarness into the real TokenViewStepContent when wiring computedSource. (3) VQ-S2-016 - re-evaluate splitting UNAVAILABLE_REASON once computedSource can actually fail; S3 is what makes it fail. (4) invariant-format-precondition-join - validated at the RESOLUTION layer (resolveBoundarySource), not the render layer; whichever layer drops boundaries must also decide the label. AC-TOK-5's wrong-source risk is how S3 breaks it; symptom is a silently-unavailable computed source. (5) public-contract-computed-source-stability - THREE constraints must survive S3's wiring: inline lambdas are safe (ref read-through), presence tracked by a stable boolean in deps, and the ref-update effect MUST stay declared above the fetch effect (reordering breaks arrival silently). (6) path-tokenizer-suite-node-env - tokenizer tests in tests/integration (node), never tests/unit (jsdom). (7) path-test-fixtures + path-stream-transcript-fixtures - oracle values READ FROM the recording, never restated as literals. S1 needed two rounds to get this right; S3 has vocab AND golden fixtures. (8) public-contract-tokenize-wire - correlate by requestId; backend-client.handleServerMessage:60 drops conversationId-less messages, so the tokenize branch must sit ahead of that guard. (9) validation-provider-type-gate - AC-ERR-2 gates on ProviderConfig.type, never provider name; also the likely trigger for conditional computedSource supply. (10) convention-duplicated-step-type - S3 adds tokenize wire payload types; both declarations move together. S3 RISK: first story where a test can be CONFIDENTLY WRONG rather than merely thin - tokens.join('')===s holds for many segmentations that are not the model's. AC-TOK-7's golden fixture is the only thing between 'well-formed' and 'correct'. CARRY TO S4: 45 of 60 AC-STRUCT-3 lines remain; S1-F9/S2-F5 persistence-signal gap routes at wrap-up.
